title: Governments hide the bodies for Cold War reverse engineering

tellings.quote: One of the governments most interested in hiding things is the one that does the most reverse engineering. And those have been all the things that happened during the Cold War era.

plain: The governments most eager to hide strange bodies and objects are the ones doing the most reverse engineering, meaning taking apart unknown technology to learn how to copy it, and much of that work began in the Cold War. David Ruiz, a researcher who has studied the three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru, says this to Michels without naming a source, as his explanation for why such finds are kept from the public.
